src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_cd116_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 116th Congress's districts (its file says session 116). The Bureau published no file of the 117th Congress's districts, the Congress the 2020 election chose.
rec: S.B. 3002 (2011 Third Special Session): four districts (the new fourth seat after the 2010 census)
Utah Legislature: S.B. 3002, 2011 Third Special Session, 'Congressional Boundaries Designation' (enrolled)

Passed 2011-10-17, signed 2011-10-20 (Deseret News); used 2012 through 2020. Voters' Proposition 4 (2018) changed the process but no map before 2021. Census file: the Bureau's user note says its products hold the 116th Congress and the 2018 election-year legislative lines and none of the later changes; the cached cb_2020 files carry CDSESSN 116 / LSY 2018. Cached files: cb_2020 cd116 has 4 Utah districts, none matching cb_2022.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: S.B. 3001 (2011 Third Special Session) as adjusted by S.B. 125 (2012 General Session); 29 Senate districts
Utah Legislature: S.B. 3001, 2011 Third Special Session, 'Utah State Senate Boundaries and Election Designation' (enrolled)

Signed 2011-10-20 (SB 125 on 2012-01-30, per press summaries). The 2021 bill's list of amended sections shows later technical amendments to Utah's district sections (Laws of Utah 2013 ch. 454 and 2018 ch. 330; what they changed was not read), and the Bureau's 2018 page lists Utah among states that delineated new legislative boundaries for 2018; the cb_2020 file carries those 2018 lines (LSY 2018). I found no new plan between 2011 and 2021. Census file: the Bureau's user note says its products hold the 116th Congress and the 2018 election-year legislative lines and none of the later changes; the cached cb_2020 files carry CDSESSN 116 / LSY 2018.
